name: Zone entry, LW carrying
caption: Your LW is carrying the puck up the left boards with speed and is about to cross their blue line. You are on the right side, skating with him and a few feet short of the line. Both their D are backing in and their forwards are chasing.

options.text: Drive wide down the right with speed, staying onside, to stretch their D and open the middle for the center.
options.feedback: Right. Width is your job on the entry. Their D have to respect you, which gives the center the middle lane and your LW room to cut in.

options.text: Cut into the middle lane early to be the pass option.
options.feedback: The center is driving the middle. Two in the middle and nobody wide lets their D squeeze the whole entry into one lane.

options.text: Slow down at the blue line to make sure I stay onside.
options.feedback: Staying onside matters, but the puck is on the far wall, so you have time. Slowing to a stop kills the entry; adjust your line, not your speed.

options.text: Stop at the blue line and wait to see what happens.
options.feedback: Then their right D has nobody to worry about and can slide over to help on your LW. Keep skating.

questions.prompt: Tap where you want to be two seconds from now.
questions.label: Wide lane

fb.right: Wide and deep, just inside the line. Their right D has to honour you and the middle opens for your center.
fb.close: Right lane. Keep driving: deeper and wider pulls their D with you; stopping short lets him cheat to the middle.
fb.wrong: The center has the middle. Your lane is the outside, and you want to be past their D, not beside him.
